facts.fact: Decree No. 40/2026 of the Council of Ministers, on Simple Prior Notification for economic activities, gives the electronic signature the same legal standing as a handwritten one, as reported by Lusa via 360 Mozambique; the regime takes effect within 90 days and the decree's own date is not given, so this is dated to the published date.
facts.system: Decree No. 40/2026 (Regulation on Simple Prior Notification)
